# Welcome!

I am an **Associate Teaching Professor** in the [Department of Mathematics](https://cos.northeastern.edu/mathematics/) at [Northeastern University](https://www.northeastern.edu/). My academic background is in [algebraic topology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebraic_topology), [group theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_theory), and their connections with [algebra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebra), [geometry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geometry), [data science](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_science), and [artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence).

Before joining Northeastern as a faculty member, I was a **Postdoctoral Fellow** at the [University of Nevada, Reno](https://www.unr.edu/) from 2016 to 2019, working with [Chris Rogers](https://hoalg.net/chrisrogers/). I received my Ph.D. in Mathematics from [Northeastern University](https://www.northeastern.edu/) in 2016 under the supervision of [Alexandru I. Suciu](https://web.northeastern.edu/suciu/). I received my M.S. in Mathematics from [Nankai University](https://en.nankai.edu.cn/) in 2010 and my B.S. in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics from [Hebei Normal University](https://en.hebtu.edu.cn/) in 2007.

My research and teaching connect [algebraic topology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebraic_topology), [group theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_theory), [applied mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applied_mathematics), [linear algebra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_algebra), [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning), [stochastic processes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stochastic_process), [topological data analysis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological_data_analysis), and [AI-enhanced mathematics education](https://learning.northeastern.edu/ai-gallery/).

:::

## Research and Scholarly Interests

My research interests are in [algebraic topology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebraic_topology) and [group theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_theory), together with their connections with [algebra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebra), [geometry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geometry), [combinatorics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Combinatorics), [data science](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_science), and [AI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence). I am also interested in applications to [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning), [deep learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deep_learning), and [topological data analysis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological_data_analysis). See the [Research page](research.qmd) for publications, abstracts, and seminar notes.

::: {.grid}
::: {.card}
### Algebraic Topology and Homotopy Theory

[Rational homotopy theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rational_homotopy_theory), moduli spaces of $C_\infty$-structures, [formality](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formality_theorem), [Massey products](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massey_product), [spectral sequences](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spectral_sequence), and stable homotopy computations.
:::

::: {.card}
### Groups, Lie Algebras, and Jumping Loci

[Cohomology jumping loci](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cohomology_jump_locus), characteristic varieties, resonance varieties, [Chen ranks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chen_groups), [lower central series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lower_central_series) ranks, holonomy Lie algebras, and formality properties of finitely generated groups.
:::

::: {.card}
### Configuration Spaces and Braid-Type Groups

[Configuration spaces](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Configuration_space_(mathematics)), [pure braid groups](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Braid_group), pure virtual braid groups, pure welded braid groups, [McCool groups](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automorphism_group_of_a_free_group), fundamental groups of algebraic varieties, and related combinatorial structures.
:::

::: {.card}
### Topological Data Analysis

[Persistent homology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Persistent_homology), [simplicial complexes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplicial_complex), shape of data, computational topology, and the use of algebraic-topological ideas in [data science](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_science).
:::

::: {.card}
### Random Graphs and RAAGs

[Random right-angled Artin groups](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Right-angled_Artin_group), [clique complexes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clique_complex), [Betti numbers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Betti_number), resonance varieties, Chen ranks, and probabilistic algebraic topology.
:::

::: {.card}
### Mathematics of AI

[Linear algebra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_algebra), [probability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probability_theory), [optimization](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematical_optimization), and geometry as foundations for [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning) and [artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence).
:::
:::

## Teaching

My teaching combines mathematical structure, computational experimentation, real data, and project-based learning. The materials on this website are mainly lecture notes, syllabi, course pages, and public resources. Full course sites, assignments, computer labs, exams, and projects are usually hosted on [Northeastern Canvas](https://canvas.northeastern.edu/).

## Program Leadership

I serve as a program director for graduate programs in the [Department of Mathematics](https://cos.northeastern.edu/mathematics/) at [Northeastern University](https://www.northeastern.edu/). My work includes curriculum development, student advising, interdisciplinary program planning, experiential learning, industry connections, and support for graduate student success.
:::

## Seminars, Student Activities, and Outreach

::: {.grid}
::: {.card}
### AIM Seminar

I organize the [Northeastern Applied and Interdisciplinary Mathematics Seminar](https://aimath.sites.northeastern.edu/), which supports conversations across mathematics, computation, modeling, and applications.
:::

::: {.card}
### Data Club

I organize the [Northeastern Graduate Math Data Club](https://aimc.sites.northeastern.edu/) for MS students in the mathematics department. The club supports student learning in [Python](https://www.python.org/), [SQL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SQL), data science, machine learning, projects, career preparation, and peer collaboration.
:::

::: {.card}
### Talks and Teaching Innovation

My talks and posters include topics in [algebraic topology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algebraic_topology), group theory, matrix methods, AI in mathematics education, and machine learning in the applied mathematics curriculum. See the [Talks page](talks.qmd) for selected talks, posters, and workshop materials.
:::
